# Local browser dependencies

- PDF.js 5.6.205 (pdfjs-dist): pdf.min.mjs and pdf.worker.min.mjs.
  Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
  License: Apache-2.0; see PDFJS-LICENSE.
- JSZip 3.10.1: jszip.min.js.
  Source: https://github.com/Stuk/jszip
  License: MIT or GPLv3; see JSZIP-LICENSE.md (MIT chosen for this distribution).

These files are copied from the installed runtime dependencies so resume parsing works without a third-party CDN.
